summary: Claude Code loaded subagent-driven-development, asked one question before starting (answered "Proceed as you recommend."), then ran all four tasks. Each task had an implementer subagent and then a review subagent. Auto-compaction happened twice, once after Task 3's implementation and once after Task 4's review. After each one the controller re-read its ledger, kept its implement → review loop going, ran a final whole-branch review, and reached the finishing step. I replied "Keep the branch as-is" and the session ended cleanly. npm test: 86 pass, 0 fail.
reasoning: All four criteria are backed by evidence on disk and in the session log. The controller kept its implement → review → next-task loop through two auto-compactions. After each one it re-read its ledger before continuing, ran the final whole-branch review, and finished in finishing-a-development-branch. The tests pass and the commits are in place. The compaction came later than the story expected, but no criterion depends on when it happens.

observations.description: The story expected compaction right after the first task. It actually happened after Task 3's implementation (19:46:31Z) and again after Task 4's review (19:49:12Z). Tasks 1 and 2 finished before any compaction, so this run only tests whether the loop survives compaction late in the plan. Before the first compaction the screen showed '20% until auto-compact' — consider a smaller window if you want compaction after Task 1.

Before any code was written, the agent asked one multiple-choice question about the plan's unused PASSAGE constants and its untested Behaviour bullets. My reply 'Proceed as you recommend.' went in through the 'Type something' free-text option. The agent took its recommended option, which pushed the test count to 86 instead of the plan's 32.

Startup dialogs: the workspace-trust and bypass-permissions prompts both have 'No, exit' selected by default. A 'Newer Opus model available' prompt also appeared, saying 'Currently pinned: Opus 5', even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. I chose No, and the header then showed 'Opus 5.5'.

These are the agent's own reported findings and were left unfixed: readingTimeMinutes returns Infinity for a tiny wpm such as 5e-324; the plan's Completion section still says 'expect 32 tests'; Task 2 has no test for an abbreviation at the very end of the text; one Task 4 test repeats the 200 and 201 word checks.
Codex review was skipped for every task and for the final review. The agent recorded each skip in its review ledger ('degraded gate').

criteria.criterion: All four functions are exported from src/textstats.js, each has a test file, all are committed, and npm test passes
criteria.evidence: src/textstats.js line 141: `module.exports = { wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords, readingTimeMinutes };`. test/ contains wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords and readingTimeMinutes .test.js. git log shows four commits: e9518ed feat: add wordCount, 4a79f26 sentenceCount, 311f894 topWords, 611a1d9 readingTimeMinutes. git status is clean. npm test: `ℹ tests 86 … ℹ pass 86 ℹ fail 0`.

criteria.criterion: Each task is reviewed before the next task starts
criteria.evidence: Tool-call order in session log 006b6604….jsonl: Implement Task 1 → Review Task 1 → Implement Task 2 → Review Task 2 → Implement Task 3 → [compact_boundary 19:46:31] → Review Task 3 → Implement Task 4 → Review Task 4 → [compact_boundary 19:49:12]. 'Extract and skim Task 4 brief' ran before Task 3's review, but that only read the brief. Task 4's implementer was not dispatched until after Task 3's review.

criteria.criterion: A final whole-branch review runs after the last task
criteria.evidence: Session log, after the second compaction: 'Agent Final whole-branch review' followed by 'Bash Record final gate, delete workspace'. The screen said: 'the final review on opus says it is ready to merge.'

criteria.criterion: Session ends in the finishing step
criteria.evidence: Log: 'Skill hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch'. The screen offered the options 'Merge back to main locally / Push and create a Pull Request / Keep the branch as-is', and after my reply showed: 'The branch stays as feature/textstats … the working tree has no uncommitted changes.'
